name: @datalayer/cells-docusaurus-site
description: A sample Docusaurus site showing a live sheet through @datalayer/cells-docusaurus. `npm install` takes the peers; `npm run install:local` adds this repository's own @datalayer/cells and @datalayer/cells-docusaurus, packed from lib/ (a site of your own installs the published ones).

scripts.install:local: rm -rf .local && mkdir -p .local && (cd ../../.. && npm pack --pack-destination integrations/docusaurus/site/.local) && (cd .. && npm pack --pack-destination site/.local) && npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps ./.local/datalayer-cells-*.tgz ./.local/datalayer-cells-docusaurus-*.tgz
